description: No single existential sentence in the language of equality alone is true exactly in the infinite nonempty structures.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Preservation.infinitude_not_existential :
  ¬∃ σ,
      FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsExistential σ ∧
        ∀ (M : Type) (x : FirstOrder.Language.empty.Structure M), Nonempty M → (M ⊨ σ ↔ Infinite M)
